Visitor modifies element at end after children processed

```java title="Java"
import io.xberg.htmltomarkdown.*;

public final class Example {
    public static void main(String[] args) throws Exception {
        class _TestVisitor implements HtmlVisitor {
            @Override public VisitResult visitElementEnd(NodeContext ctx, String output) {
                return new VisitResult.Custom("MODIFIED OUTPUT");
            }
        }
        var visitor = new _TestVisitor();
        var result = HtmlToMarkdownRs.convert("<blockquote><p>Original quote</p></blockquote>", ConversionOptions.builder().withVisitor(visitor).build());
        System.out.println(result);
    }
}
```
